description:
ROUND-38 EMISSION ITEM (filed s500p, perf round 37 was RUNTIME-ONLY so it is not built here).

FINDING: a sub with a SIGNATURE (`use feature 'signatures'`, `use v5.36`) is lowered through the older text path -- `(p-sub pl-f (&rest %_args) () (p-args-body (p-check-arity …) (let* (($a (p-copy-scalar-arg (aref @_ 0)))) …)))` -- and NONE of its lexicals get the raw-numeric verdict: every `my $x = 0` is a `(make-p-box nil)` + `p-my-=`, every `$x += …` a `p-incf` on a box, every comparison the operator's SLOW path.  The same body written as `my $a = shift; …` gets `p-raw-params` + `(p-let (($sum :scalar 0)))` + `p-incf-raw`.

REPRODUCER (scratch/s500p/sig.pl in the s500p worktree):
    use feature 'signatures'; no warnings;
    sub f ($a) { my $sum = 0; my $d = 0; while ($d < 10) { $sum += $d * $a; $d += 1 } $sum }
    sub g { my $a = shift; my $sum = 0; my $d = 0; while ($d < 10) { $sum += $d * $a; $d += 1 } $sum }
  ./pl2cl: f's $sum is `(let (($sum (make-p-box nil))) (p-my-= $sum 0) … (p-incf $sum …))`; g's is `(p-let (($sum :scalar 0)) … (p-incf-raw $sum …))`.

PROFILE LINES THAT MOTIVATE IT (s500p Step 0, main 209e7533, sb-sprof 0.5 ms):
  0041-Air-mass (1.49 s vs perl 0.60 s; every sub has a signature): %make-p-box 8.8 % self, make-p-box 12.0 % total, p-copy-scalar-arg 3.1 %, box-set 4.8 %, to-number 4.2 %, %p-*-slow 5.7 %, %p->-slow 3.6 %, %p-<-slow 3.2 %.
  1009-Perfect-shuffle (`use v5.36`, `sub perfect_shuffle (@deck)`): see #2515 for the array half.
Modern Perl (v5.36+) turns signatures on by default, so this is the shape new programs are written in.

SIZE BEFORE BUILDING: hand-edit Air-mass's emitted .lisp so the three subs use the p-raw-params/p-let :scalar shape and time it against the original (the s469bh ab-lisp method) -- that is the ceiling.  #2513 (s500p) already cut the boxed operators' slow-path cost; this item removes the boxes.


=== DONE (s501q) ===
SHIPPED as Kind-A `sig-classic` (Pl/Passes.pm).  Parser2::_normalize_signature_subs rewrites the PPI TREE before every rename/scope pass: a NAMED sub whose signature is only plain named parameters (scalars, then at most one slurpy @/%), no default, no placeholder, one line, no `state`, and whose body does not observe @_ (the ONE predicate _body_observes_args, #2572) loses its signature and gains a leading `my (PARAMS) = @_;` -- so it takes the classic spelling's lowering (p-raw-params / p-args-body :copy, raw p-let slots).  The arity check is kept: `(p-check-arity â¦)` first in p-args-body, or the `(:arity NAME MIN MAX FLEX HASH-START)` clause of p-raw-params; messages unchanged (v1's).  The call sites keep the signature's prototype record; a `:prototype(â¦)` attribute's record (s500a #2533) is never overwritten (fixed at the s502 rebase -- transpile-test-07 caught it).  Everything else (defaults, placeholders, `()`, multi-line, anon subs, bodies using @_) keeps v1's binding.  ir-spec Â§5.2 (normative).

Final-tree numbers: FINAL TREE (s503, 71bd29ef on main 2284d58d, quiet box load 0.8-1.7, bench-exec BENCH_K=5 two interleaved passes vs base-2284d58d, scratch/s501q/bench-final/table.txt): sigarith 0.1163 -> 0.0235 s (-79.8 %, 0.22x of perl), passarr 0.2683 -> 0.1683 (-37.3 %), listdeclcat 0.4491 -> 0.2213 (-50.7 %), lcbytes 0.1534 -> 0.1422 (-7.3 %; 209e7533 0.1134), ucshort 0.1074 -> 0.1077 (+0.3 %, ctl +1.2 %; 209e7533 0.1046), methret +2.0 % (rerun -2.1 %); real programs (realprog-final.txt, K=5): Air-mass 1.303 -> 0.979 s (-24.9 %), Perfect-shuffle 0.620 -> 0.437 (-29.6 %), Sub-unit-squares 0.425 -> 0.327 (-22.9 %), ctl <= 0.4 %; compile time +0.4 % wall over 111 files.
